19.t: Working with data: counting dividing cells
q: Which stage was seen most often?
Calculate the total number of cells near the tip.
Calculate the percentage of cells dividing (not in interphase) near the tip and at 5 mm.
Explain what these data show about where a root grows.
Most mitosis happens near the tip, so new cells are made there; further back cells stop dividing and get longer instead.
